description: List prescriptions, optionally filtered by status and/or DEA schedule. Sorted by prescribed_on desc.

dea_schedule.description: Optional: non_controlled | II | III | IV | V.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of Prescription objects.

description: Get a single prescription by rxid.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the Prescription object.

description: Create a new prescription. Status starts as 'active'. An audit log entry is recorded.

prescribed_on.description: ISO date the prescription was written.

dea_schedule.description: DEA schedule: non_controlled | II | III | IV | V.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the new Prescription.

description: Update mutable fields on an existing prescription. Only supplied fields change. Records an audit entry.

status.description: Optional new status: active | expired | cancelled | filled.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the updated Prescription.

description: Cancel a prescription (sets status to 'cancelled'). Records an audit entry.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the cancelled Prescription.

description: List refill requests, optionally filtered by prescription and/or status. Sorted by requested_at desc.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of RefillRequest objects.

description: Create a new pending refill request. Fails if the prescription is not active or has no refills remaining.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the new RefillRequest.

description: Mark a pending refill as filled. Decrements refills_remaining on the parent prescription and records an audit entry.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the filled RefillRequest.

description: Reject a pending refill with a reason. Records an audit entry.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the rejected RefillRequest.

description: Get a single pharmacy by phid.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the Pharmacy object.

description: Add a new pharmacy to the directory.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the new Pharmacy.

description: List audit log entries, optionally filtered by prescription. Sorted by timestamp desc.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of AuditLog entries.

description: Search prescriptions across medication_name, prescribed_by, dosage, and frequency.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of matching prescriptions.

description: Return every prescription whose dea_schedule is not 'non_controlled'.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of controlled-substance prescriptions sorted by DEA schedule.

description: Return active prescriptions that expire within the next N days from the anchor date.

today.description: Optional anchor ISO date; defaults to the session's initial day.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of Prescription objects sorted by expires_on.

description: Aggregate counts across prescriptions, refills, pharmacies, and audit logs, grouped by status/schedule.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is an aggregate stats object.
